=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32060-32095 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When both state-file rewrite attempts fail, the code logs `state_update_failed` but still bumps the no-op counter, relabels the source `ai:closed` and closes it, leaving the replacement issue untracked in the wave state.
  WHY: The poller cannot manage or retry the orphaned replacement. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash examined this and rejected it as an intentional trade-off that prevents a duplicate replacement every poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32070 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If the final rewrite attempt has a successful `jq` but a failed `mv`, the loop ends without running `rm` on the stale `.tmp` file.
  WHY: A stale `STATE_FILE.tmp` would stay on disk (rated NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash found that the `rm -f` at line 32070 runs after every failed attempt, so no stale file is left.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5

The contract test inspects only from the snapshot read onward. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash concluded this is not a gap (NIT, confidence 2), and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 also rejected it.
